arguments.text: Good start. Settle now into your long race rhythm.

8000 m, out-and-back 1250 m legs. Settle after the hard start to about sustainable pace (pod near 167-175 W). Hold even effort near critical power through the middle; compare legs in the same direction to separate current from fatigue. Watch for anything that slows the boat while pod power holds (rudder weed, drag, wind) and for pod drift (pod and boat-model power disagreeing). Final push from about 1000-1500 m left if reserve allows; finish sprint last 300-400 m.

arguments.name: drag_gap
arguments.description: GPS speed shortfall vs pod power, net of fitted current; strongly negative = extra drag (weed, rudder) or pod reading high

arguments.message: Boat slower than pod power predicts beyond current: check weed/rudder drag vs pod drift (compare speed_gps vs shaft_power).
Boat faster than pod predicts: pod reading low, or new tailwind/current.
Pod reserve below 30 percent: check whether there is enough distance left; ease if far from finish.
Pod power well below critical power for a minute: paddler fading, blowing up, or pod drifting.

arguments.reason: Check the paddler settled after the start cue.

arguments.text: Min 1: start hard (boat 143 W vs CP 108, pod 216 vs 167, pod reserve 75 pct). Cued ease to 163 s/500. Watches: extra_drag (drag_gap=push_local-push_along < -0.2 for 40 s), pod_low_or_tailwind (> 0.3 for 60 s), reserve_low_early (pod reserve < 30 pct), power_drop (pod < 85 pct CP for 60 s). At min 1 push_local was already +0.2-0.26 with push_along about 0 (eta estimate may still be settling).

text: Cued ease to 163 s/500 to settle after a hard start; set plan, drag/pod/reserve watches and a 2-minute check.

arguments.text: Too hot for eight k. Ease to 165 pace and hold it.

arguments.reason: Check whether the ease to 165 took; pod reserve was 40 pct at min 3.2.

text: Cued ease to 165 s/500: pod reserve 40 pct at min 3, still 13 pct over critical power; check in 90 s.

arguments.message: Pod reserve below 15 pct with more than 1500 m to go: ease to protect from blow-up.
Pod power 8 pct over sustainable for a minute: paddler drifting hot.
Pod power 8 pct under sustainable for 90 s: paddler drifting slow (or pod drift).

arguments.text: Min 4.7: second ease cue took; pod 173 W vs sustainable 168, boat 109 vs CP 108, pod reserve 31 pct (spent in hard start). Hold sustainable now. Watches changed: reserve_low_early now pod reserve < 15 pct with > 1500 m left; too_hot (pod > 108 pct sustainable 60 s); too_slow (pod < 92 pct sustainable 90 s).

text: no cue: paddler settled at sustainable power; retuned reserve watch and added too_hot / too_slow pacing watches.

arguments.text: Ease a touch to 166. Long way, smooth and relaxed.

Min 7.7 (leg 2, heading south): drifted hot again, pod 180 W vs sustainable 168, pod reserve 15 pct, boat reserve 22 pct. Paddler says 9/10, hurting, not sure can hold. Consistent with CP calibration roughly right. Cued ease to 166. Do not let them run the reserve empty mid-race.

arguments.reason: Check ease to 166 took and reserve is no longer draining.

text: Cued ease to 166: pod 7 pct over sustainable, reserve 15 pct, paddler 9/10 hurting.
no cue: ease cue given 13 s ago, too early to judge; check already set for race second 574.

arguments.text: Back off now, you are on the limit. Settle at 168.

Min 9.6: ease to 166 at min 7.9 was NOT followed (pod stayed 178-181 W). Pod reserve 3 pct, boat reserve 12 pct, 6.2 km left. Cued firmer ease to 168 to avoid blow-up. Paddler tends to drift back to about 180 W pod; may need repeated firm cues. Once stable near CP, keep it there; reserve near zero means no surges until final 1 km.

arguments.reason: Check whether firm ease to 168 took; pod reserve 3 pct at min 9.6.

text: Cued firm ease to 168: previous ease ignored, pod reserve 3 pct with 6.2 km left.

arguments.text: Ease right off now, breathe, recover. Paddle 170 pace.

Min 10.9: pod reserve 0, boat reserve 8 pct, paddler 10/10 I am done, still at 180 W pod despite 3 ease cues. Cued ease to 170 to recover. If blow-up comes (pod well below CP), let them recover then rebuild to about 163-165 pod W; do not push until final km.

arguments.reason: Check for blow-up or whether ease to 170 took.

text: Cued ease to 170: pod reserve empty, paddler says 10/10 and done; trying to avert a blow-up.

arguments.text: Min 12.2: pod now 172 W (down from 180), boat 106 W, fade -2.4 pct, pod reserve modelled 0 for 2 min but no blow-up yet. 4 of 5 ease cues were not followed; stopped repeating them. If pod holds 170-180 W for several more minutes with no collapse, CP/reserve calibration is probably low (consider set_critical_power cp_shaft about 175).

arguments.reason: Recheck: blow-up, or evidence critical power is set too low.

text: no cue: paddler now easing to about critical power on their own; repeated ease cues were ignored, watching for blow-up.

arguments.text: That is your pace. Hold this rhythm, steady and long.

Min 14.4: no blow-up; paddler settled to CP on own (pod 168-171 W, boat 103-109 W). Legs: leg1 out 3.11 m/s at pod 185; leg2 back 3.07 at 178; leg3 out 2.93 at 168. drag_gap near 0 all race (no extra drag; current weak, push_along about +-0.04). Cued hold at 167. Pod reserve modelled 0, boat reserve 15 pct.

text: Cued hold at 167: paddler has settled to critical power, no extra drag seen; anchoring them there.

arguments.message: Boat-model power 8 pct over sustainable for a minute (independent of the pod).

arguments.name: boat_per_pod
arguments.description: Share of pod power that shows up as boat-model power; about 0.61-0.63 in legs 1-3; a drop with steady speed suggests the pod reading high

arguments.text: Min 17.3 (leg 3 out, 560 m before turn): pod power ramped smoothly 174 to 198 W over 80 s while GPS speed (3.02) and water speed (3.05), rate 64 and boat power (112 W) stayed flat. Likely POD DRIFT reading high (alternatives: headwind building or new drag while paddler pushes harder). Paddler answer unchanged 10/10 I am done (same canned words as min 10.9, not informative). Trust boat-model numbers (power_w, reserve_left_pct) over pod ones until resolved. Test: after the turn a headwind becomes a tailwind; pod drift persists both ways. Removed pod-based too_hot watch, added boat_too_hot.

arguments.reason: After the turn: compare pod vs boat power and GPS speed to separate pod drift from wind or drag.

text: no cue: pod power rising with flat speed looks like pod drift; switched to boat-model watches, will test after the turn.
no cue: stale pod-based too_hot alert, already diagnosed as likely pod drift; boat-model power steady near critical power.

arguments.reason: Race committee radio at min 19.7: course extended by one leg, finish now at 9250 m.

arguments.text: Committee extended course one leg. 5.6 k to go now.

Race now 9250 m (radio at min 19.7 added one 1250 m leg; set_race_distance done, paddler told 5.6 k to go). Out-and-back 1250 m legs. Hold even effort at about critical power (boat-model power about 108-113 W) to the final km. Pod appears to be drifting high since min 16 (pod 210 W vs boat 112 W at flat speed): trust boat-model numbers until resolved. Watch for drag (speed drop at same effort), wind, more radio changes. Final push from about 1000 m left only if not fading; finish sprint last 300-400 m.

Min 19.7: radio extended course to 9250 m; set_race_distance(9250) and cue tell 5630 m left. Pod now 211 W and plateaued, boat 112-113 W, speed flat 3.02 GPS: pod drift about +25 pct likely. Boat reserve model now 0 pct but paddler has held boat 112 W for 10 min without collapse: CP may be set low (boat maybe 112-115 W).

text: Radio extended race to 9250 m: set race distance, told paddler 5.6 k to go, updated plan.

arguments.message: Boat-model power under 88 pct of CP for 45 s: blow-up, new drag, or easing.
GPS speed under 2.85 m/s at normal rate for 40 s: drag (weed), headwind/current, or fading.

arguments.reason: Decide on final push for the last 1300 m.

arguments.text: Min 21.4 (leg 4 back, after turn): pod still 211 W, push_local still -0.16 after the turn, so not wind; speed unchanged at same rate, so POD DRIFT (reads about 25 pct high), not drag. Ignore pod numbers. Removed all pod-based watches; now boat_power_drop (boat < 88 pct CP 45 s), slow_boat (GPS < 2.85 at rate > 61 for 40 s), boat_too_hot. Wake-ups set at 1300 m and 450 m left for final push and sprint.

text: no cue: paddler steady at about critical power; pod drift confirmed after the turn, switched to boat-based watches and set finish wake-ups.
no cue: steady at critical power (boat 108-111 W, GPS 3.03-3.05 m/s, rate 64), nothing to change.

arguments.text: Min 27.3 (at turn 4 to 5, 4256 m left): boat power fell 108 to 91 W, GPS 3.03 to 2.89, pod fell 217 to 184 (same 15 pct drop on both, so effort drop not drag). Either the turn or a blow-up (true reserve ran out after long spell at CP+). Checking again 90 s after the turn.

arguments.reason: After turn 4-5: is boat power back near 105-110 W, or still blown up near 90 W?

text: no cue: power drop coincides with the turn and a likely blow-up; rechecking 90 s after the turn before acting.

arguments.text: You are fine. Breathe, recover, long smooth strokes. Rebuild soon.

Min 28.1: CONFIRMED BLOW-UP at about race s 1570 (min 26.2): pod dropped 218 to 182 in 30 s and boat 109 to 87-90 W, boat-per-pod ratio unchanged (0.50) so no drag. 4.1 km left. Cued reassure. Plan: let them recover, then hold slightly BELOW old level (boat about 103-106 W, pace about 167-168) to avoid a second blow-up; final push only in last 600-800 m.

arguments.reason: Check recovery from blow-up; when boat power is back near 100+ W, cue hold at about 167.

text: Cued reassure: paddler blew up at min 26 (effort forced down, no drag); letting them recover, wake-up at race s 1732 already pending.

arguments.text: Race 9250 m (radio extended it at min 19.7; paddler told). Pod drifts high since min 16 (reads about 25 pct over): use boat-model power and GPS only. Paddler BLEW UP at min 26.2 after long spell at boat 109-112 W (true limit about there). Now: let them recover, then hold boat about 103-106 W (pace about 167-168 over ground) to avoid a second blow-up. Final push from about 700 m left, sprint last 300 m. Boat reserve model is unreliable (said empty at min 18.5).

arguments.reason: Recovery check: if boat power back near 100-106 W, cue hold at 167-168 to stop a second overshoot.

text: no cue: recovering from blow-up (boat 99 W and rising); updated plan, rechecking in 90 s.

arguments.text: Good recovery. Hold right here, 168 pace, no surges yet.

Min 30.5: recovered from blow-up, boat 106 W rising, GPS 2.94-2.99, 3.7 km left. Cued hold at 168 to cap at about 104-106 W boat. If they creep back above 110 W boat for a minute (boat_too_hot or manual check), cue hold again.

arguments.message: Boat power over 111 W for a minute with more than 800 m left: creeping back toward the blow-up level.

text: Cued hold at 168 after recovery to avoid a second blow-up; boat_too_hot watch now a fixed 111 W threshold.
no cue: holding boat 105-109 W at 167 pace after recovery, under the 111 W watch; 3.2 km left.

arguments.text: Ease a hair to 169. Save it for the last 700.

Min 34.2: paddler said I am cooked, cannot hold this, at boat 106-108 W, 3.0 km left. After last such words they lasted 15 min before blowing up. Cued small ease to 169 as cheap insurance against a second blow-up (about 2 pct power). Final push at about 700 m left.

text: Cued small ease to 169: paddler says cooked at about critical power with 3 km left; insurance against a second blow-up.

arguments.text: Min 37.2 (leg 6 back, 2.5 km left): ease to 169 took, slightly more than asked: boat 99-102 W, GPS 2.94 (170 pace), pod 184. Now a bit below CP, so some reserve rebuilding for the finish. Plan: at 1300 m left lift to about 165-166 pace (boat about 108-110 W), at 450 m left cue finish sprint.

text: no cue: paddler at the requested 169-170 pace, slightly under critical power, saving reserve for a lift at 1300 m left.
no cue: ease faded on its own back to boat 105-106 W at 166.6 pace, about right; lift planned at 1300 m left.

arguments.text: 1400 to go. Lift now to 165, strong and long.

arguments.reason: Finish sprint cue (last turn at 8750 m, then 500 m to the line).
Check the lift to 165 is holding without a blow-up.

arguments.text: Race 9250 m. Final phase: at 1444 m left (min 43.2) cued push to 165 pace (boat about 110 W). Last turn at 8750 m, then 500 m to the line. At 450 m left cue finish sprint. Pod reads about 25 pct high since min 16: use boat-model power and GPS. Paddler blew up once at min 26.2 at boat 109-112 W; if power collapses under 95 W before 600 m left, ease back to 168 and sprint only the last 250 m.

text: Cued push to 165 with 1444 m left using reserve rebuilt since the blow-up; sprint wake-up at 450 m.

arguments.text: Under one k left. You have it in you. Push to 164.

text: Re-cued push to 164 with 985 m left: first push cue was not followed (boat power unchanged at 105 W); sprint wake-up at 450 m.

arguments.text: Last 450. Sprint now, everything to the line!
